name: set_text_window_item_name

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_SetTextWindowItemName consumes a window ID and item ID, resolves the item descriptor through func_001479C0, selects the corresponding item-name lookup table, and installs the resulting text mapping in the requested active window

notes: The handler classifies the item descriptor into the same fixed item-ID ranges used by command 644 get_item_category, configures D_00383CD0 for the selected item-name table, and binds that mapping to the requested text-window slot. The two JP calls reopen window 7 and pass item IDs 24 and 36 in reward sequences; those same IDs are subsequently granted by command 583.
